tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: List the newest published changes on AiSeek (verified changes in economy, markets, policy, technology, companies and science), newest first, 20 per page. Use it to see what is new; to look for a subject, company or country use search_changes, to browse a curated subject use list_topics, and for a di

tools.name: search_changes
tools.description: Search published changes by words, ranked by relevance, best first, not by time. Use it to find changes about a company, country, subject or name; to browse what is newest use list_changes, for a curated subject use get_topic, for a company's profile use search_companies. Parameters: query is matche

tools.name: get_change
tools.description: Get one published change with its scores, main subject and every outlet that reported it (name, link, date, evidence level, role). Use it after list_changes, search_changes or get_topic to see who reported a change; for its receipts and what AiSeek knew earlier use get_change_history. Parameters: id

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List AiSeek's published topics: curated subjects (a technology, an industry, a policy area) that group related changes, with their counts for the last 90 and 7 days and their newest change. Use it to browse by subject or category and to find a slug for get_topic; for free-text search use search_chan

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Get one published topic and up to 50 of its published changes from the last 90 days, most relevant first. Use it after list_topics to read what is happening in a subject; for words that are not a topic use search_changes, for the newest changes overall list_changes. Parameters: slug is the topic's s

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List every country and territory AiSeek places changes in, with its name, its number of published changes in the last 7 days and its Change Heat on the last day. Use it to get all country codes at once or to see which countries have news; for heat details and seven-day series use get_country_heat, f

tools.name: get_country_heat
tools.description: Get SeekEarth's Change Heat per country: how much verified change each country had against its own recent normal, 0 to 100, where 50 is an ordinary day; it measures change, never danger or instability. Use it to see where things are changing; for all country codes use list_countries, for the changes

tools.name: list_scheduled_events
tools.description: List scheduled decisions and releases in a time range, in time order: central-bank decisions, statistics, earnings, rule effective dates, comment deadlines, trade measures, filings, meetings, votes, launches and speeches. tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search AiSeek's public companies by name, alias or ticker and return up to 10 matches, most active first, each with its slug, home country, listings and page url. Use it to find a company's slug for get_company; for news about a company use search_changes with its name. Parameters: query takes a nam

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get a company's AiSeek profile: name, home country, legal name, website, listings, description, recent published changes, the facts AiSeek states about it and its relations to other entities. Use it after search_companies. Do not use it to search by name (search_companies) or for news about the comp
